title: A Busy Thursday
setting: A family house: a messy bedroom and a sunny kitchen.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben, a boy of ten with short brown hair and a green T-shirt

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna, his older sister with long blonde hair in a ponytail

sentences.en: Ben wakes up at seven o'clock on Thursday.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a boy of ten with short brown hair and a green T-shirt wakes up in bed, an alarm clock on the bedside table, morning light at the window.

sentences.en: His clothes are all over the bedroom floor.
sentences.zh: 他的衣服扔得卧室地板上到处都是。
sentences.scene_prompt: A messy bedroom with shirts, trousers and socks all over the floor; Ben, a boy of ten with short brown hair and a green T-shirt stands in the middle.

sentences.en: He only has ten minutes for breakfast.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a boy of ten with short brown hair and a green T-shirt rushes into the kitchen, glancing at a wall clock.

sentences.en: His sister Anna cuts oranges for fresh juice.
sentences.zh: 他姐姐安娜切橙子做鲜榨果汁。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, his older sister with long blonde hair in a ponytail cuts oranges on a chopping board next to a juicer.

sentences.en: She lets him use her new blue cup.
sentences.zh: 她让他用她的新蓝杯子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, his older sister with long blonde hair in a ponytail hands a blue cup to Ben, a boy of ten with short brown hair and a green T-shirt at the kitchen table.

sentences.en: Ben loves orange juice, even in winter.
sentences.zh: 本很爱喝橙汁，就连冬天也喝。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a boy of ten with short brown hair and a green T-shirt happily drinks orange juice by a window with snow outside.

sentences.en: After a month, he feels very strong.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，他觉得自己很强壮。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a boy of ten with short brown hair and a green T-shirt proudly shows the muscles of his arm next to a calendar.
